kind: Source audit; not a node run, collateral experiment, archive implementation or measurement

findings.fact: Deposits are computed and written as a claim against the declarer bond; no transfer into separate escrow; already-poor declarers are explicitly not refused by this arm.
Actual debit is min(nominal amount, current collateral). Nominal archived deposit cannot be counted as a separately funded balance.
Removes court indexes/challenger stake, charges any remaining group, deletes groups and phase rows. This runs on objective CourtClosed too.
Only with offence_attribution_active, neutrally closes all courts on the claim through the common writer; residual-group charge is still reached.

Before the new retention guard, reverse checks were contingent on separate SharedContext/DutyClock rows. A context-valid empty book could otherwise clear unresolved bindings; native tests are run separately.

user_decision: A detailed specification and isolated implementation authorized 2026-10-21; not production adoption, pre integration, arming or deployment.
